name: availability-chaser

harness.role: Find players with no call for the next fixture and post one notice naming them.
constraints: uk english, no em dashes, no emoji
NEVER chase Belstone - real club, public data only, availability we do not have
never write a call on a player's behalf; absence of a call is the finding
one notice per fixture, never a second
harness.done_when: one notifications row of kind 'call' exists for the next fixture, or every player has called in

comms.actuation: notifications table, kind=call, read in the app by manager and coach
comms.note: no outbound email. players have no email column and inventing an address is worse than not sending.

scope: supabase://ghkazaxuznltpxfzvxny/players (kilburn-athletic only; belstone is public data, never chased)

permissions.note: the route refuses without CRON_SECRET, and RLS refuses a write outside the club. neither depends on the model

tenancy.note: two clubs share this agent. Belstone is real and public-data-only, Kilburn is fictional. the boundary is the club slug and it is enforced on the key, not in the constraints

audit.note: the notice body IS the retained input - the names that were silent at run time, kept beside the action they caused
